account_label.label: Label
account_label.description: A descriptive label for this account configuration (e.g., 'Main Business Account', 'Community Hashtag'). Helps you identify it in the list.

account_source_type.label: Source Type
account_source_type.description: Select the type of Instagram feed for this source.

account_user_id.label: User ID
account_user_id.description: Instagram User ID for this source. Required if 'User Account' is selected.

account_hashtag.label: Hashtag
account_hashtag.description: Hashtag to fetch (without #). Required if 'Hashtag' is selected.

account_access_token.label: Access Token
account_access_token.description: Instagram API Access Token for this specific source. Ensure it has the correct permissions.

attrs.placeholder: Paste Access Token for this source
